coreReferences.guidance: Read the ten LLM application risks, attack scenarios and mitigations before the design/remediation or testing exercise. Use the mappings to connect risks to controls and test cases. This is specialist reading, outside Foundation.

Use the agentic risks and mitigations when supervising agents or reviewing agent designs, tests, exposure and identity controls. Complete the full reference once; reuse it across level and role learning.

coreReferences.sourceEdition: NIST AI RMF 1.0, Playbook and GenAI Profile (AI 600-1)
coreReferences.guidance: Use Govern, Map, Measure and Manage, the Playbook and the GenAI Profile to structure the existing risk case or assurance case. The recommendation covers the full catalogue bundle; reading time is to confirm, not a fixed four-hour course.

Use MITRE tactics, techniques, mitigations and case studies to inform threat analysis, security design and adversarial tests. This is a reference, with reading time to confirm. Catalogue scores remain based on saved evidence; new releases do not automatically receive assessment credit.
coreReferences.evidenceNote: Catalogue title says v2026.08, while its saved description includes later material. MITRE v2026.10 is now available. This publication recommends the original MITRE reference without claiming edition reconciliation or revised assessment; reconcile the catalogue title and evidence in a subsequent catalogue review.

method: Best course score per outcome (0–3); equally weighted need percentages; full-course upper-bound durations; known hour subtotals with explicit unknown duration counts; shared courses, outcomes and internal items counted once. Planned coverage assumes full teaching of linked internal outcomes and is not assessed credit. Tool training is unselected and its time is additional and unknown.
